name: Idiyappam (South Indian Rice Noodles)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup raw (i.e. not roasted) rice flour
1 cup water (hot water preferred by some)

steps: Mix rice flour with hot water and salt.
Knead it into a smooth dough.
Press the dough through an idiyappam presser or sieve onto banana leaves on which a little grated coconut has been sprinkled. Alternatively, press it directly onto an idli pan without banana leaves.
Steam for 5–10 minutes. Some people add a little grated coconut on top before steaming.

culture.text: Idiyappam, also known as indiappa, noolappam, noolputtu, sheveo, santhagai, or ottu shavige, is a string hopper dish originating from southern India. It consists of rice flour pressed into noodles, laid into a flat disc-like shape and steamed. The dish also spread to Southeast Asia.
